title: read_span request
description: The params object of the `read_span` tool. The exact text of a line range, with optional context. Principal labels are never a caller field: the host supplies the scope (docs/tool-schemas.md).

end_line.description: Last line, inclusive; past the end is clamped with a warning.

context_lines.description: Lines of context before and after, 0 to 20.

roots.description: Root ids to search. Narrows the server's roots, never widens them; absent or null means every root the server allows.
